notes: Painéis deslizam pelo truss e ficam alinhados com a fila dos dois lados; cotas nas vistas de frente, trás e lado; truss de pé (na vertical) com bases de aço, Shift + roda roda a peça, seta direita põe de pé; distribuir fixtures no chão entre dois pontos; fixtures presos aos tubos; Pan (rotação da lira) e Tilt rodam a lira e a cabeça.
notesEn: Panels slide along the truss and stay in line with the row on both sides; dimensions in front, back and side views; standing (vertical) truss with steel bases, Shift + wheel turns the piece, right arrow stands it up; distribute fixtures on the floor between two points; fixtures clamp to pipes; Pan (yoke rotation) and Tilt turn the yoke and head.
